links.outcome: Dental professionals' AI knowledge and availability of AI education and training programs
links.effect: Medium to high self-reported AI knowledge, but a lack of education and training programs; organizations were not well prepared for AI implementation. 134 respondents, 78% response rate.
links.quote: Results showed excitement to implement AI in practice accompanied by medium to high knowledge and a lack of education and training programs.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of dental professionals and students assessing organizational readiness, knowledge, and attitudes toward AI integration in dental practice.
